description: This file defines the JavaEventHandler class, which handles web events by dynamically loading classes and invoking specified methods, with transaction management and debugging support.

classes.name: JavaEventHandler
classes.description: Handles web events by dynamically loading classes and invoking methods with transaction support.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class by name using the current thread's context class loader, with error logging.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler; currently a no-op.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes a specified method on a dynamically loaded class in response to an event, managing transactions and handling exceptions.
